title: Juicy Bitter Dutch Vegetable Grill
description: A hearty ovo-vegetarian Dutch dish featuring roasted vegetables and birds-eye chillies, perfect for a cozy evening meal.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the Brussels sprouts, red onion, birds-eye chillies, red bell pepper, and zucchini with olive oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder until they are evenly coated.
Grill the vegetables for about 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly charred, flipping them halfway through.
While the vegetables are grilling, slice the hard-boiled eggs into wedges.
Once the vegetables are done, remove them from the grill and let them cool for a few minutes.
To assemble the dish, place the grilled vegetables on a large platter or individual plates, then top with sliced eggs.
Serve the dish hot, garnished with additional sliced birds-eye chillies if desired.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
